evidence_level: calculated/assumed only; no printed or measured data in this folder

ordered_tests.name: selector fan-out fit coupon
ordered_tests.question: Do 4 independently rockable selector fingers and a 4-plane cam bank fit inside one 5.08 mm band on a 0.4 mm nozzle?
measurement: minimum printed web between adjacent fingers
ordered_tests.pass: web >= 0.20 mm on all 4 rows, notch present, pivot free without hand fitting
ordered_tests.kill: web < 0.20 mm or any finger fuses to its neighbour at 0.4 mm nozzle; retry once at 0.2 mm nozzle then reject S3 head density

ordered_tests.name: 2x4 loaded engage/write/disengage dwell
ordered_tests.question: Can a 2x4 full-pitch section complete a loaded dwell in <=0.60 s with checkerboard selection and no neighbour release?
ordered_tests.build: printer + coupon_base, 8 columns with passive ratchet memory (R04) and a common 4-plane cam bank
measurement: neighbour release count in 256 adversarial masks
ordered_tests.pass: all 256 binary masks correct in one dwell <=0.60 s, zero neighbour releases
ordered_tests.kill: any neighbour release, or dwell >0.60 s at the motor's measured loaded speed, or motor force >2 N

ordered_tests.name: cumulative force over 320 channels
ordered_tests.question: Does the sum of engaged-finger friction scale linearly, or does the bank stall/buckle as the engaged fraction rises?
ordered_tests.build: one full 80-column single-row cam bank on a bench, sweep engaged fraction 0..1
ordered_tests.pass: monotonic, no discontinuity, torque at 50% engaged within 1.5x the 0.1 N/finger linear prediction
ordered_tests.kill: nonlinear rise >3x linear prediction or skip onset below the S3 schedule force -> reject single-motor-per-bank

ordered_tests.name: two-tile selective and simultaneous bus coupling
ordered_tests.question: Can a printed tile clutch engage one 2x4 tile, leave its loaded neighbour stationary, then engage both without destructive torque accumulation?
ordered_tests.build: two 2x4 printed tiles, one shared shaft bus, printed dog/index clutch per tile
ordered_tests.pass: neighbour peak displacement <=0.10 mm; clutch slips before breaking; phase error at last tile <=0.25 mm
ordered_tests.kill: jam propagates to neighbour state loss, or clutch cannot disengage at 2x service torque

ordered_tests.name: correlated bus fault hunt
ordered_tests.question: How many joints before accumulated backlash exceeds the tile decoder margin?
ordered_tests.build: bench bus with 2, 4, 6, 8 joints in series
ordered_tests.pass: last-tile height error <=0.25 mm through 8 joints
ordered_tests.kill: error >0.25 mm by joint 4 -> tile size must grow or bus must be segmented

ordered_tests.name: smallest qualifying motor sample + quote
ordered_tests.question: Is there any traceable 8 mm PM motor in the same winding/shaft/step class quoted under $1.06 each at 80+spares delivered?
ordered_tests.build: buy ONE sample; request 80+spares delivered quote
ordered_tests.pass: same-part delivered quote <=$1.06 avg and a measured loaded torque-speed curve
ordered_tests.kill: no traceable 80+spares offer under the ceiling -> S5 is not product-affordable as specced

ordered_tests.name: detent/coupling 10k cycle capture
ordered_tests.question: Does a passive detent capture +/-18 deg unpowered for 10k cycles?
ordered_tests.build: flat leaf/wheel bench (Test09 Stage C), 20 release angles x 20 repeats
ordered_tests.kill: fails capture or torque collapses -> S5 passive memory unqualified

ordered_tests.name: return-friction margin on 30 cells
ordered_tests.question: Does gravity return all 5.08 mm cells with drag+uncertainty <0.5x weight at 0/1/3 deg tilt?
ordered_tests.build: Test09 Stage A 30 interchangeable cell sets, three batches
ordered_tests.pass: max drag+uncertainty <0.5x measured weight on all 30
ordered_tests.kill: any set fails -> S5 gravity return needs positive return hardware (new BOM)

ordered_tests.name: structure beam + splice
ordered_tests.question: Does a 203.2 mm printed beam with a bolted splice stay within the flatness budget under 8-beam load?
ordered_tests.build: two beam_half + two splice plates + M3 through-bolts
ordered_tests.kill: >0.25 mm -> corner-screw support rejected, 9/16-node support required (new BOM)

ordered_tests.name: regional isolation with painted miniature
ordered_tests.question: Can one 5x5 tile reset while a loaded neighbour tile and a miniature on it stay put?
ordered_tests.build: two adjacent 5x5 tiles, one loaded with a representative weighed miniature
ordered_tests.pass: neighbour peak <=0.10 mm, miniature does not move or tip
ordered_tests.kill: visible motion or tip -> S5 regional reveal requires clearing the neighbour (product weakness)
